title: Amazon SQS visibility timeout
relevantSections: Setting and adjusting visibility timeout; standard and FIFO queues
supports: Visibility controls broker eligibility; standard queues can still deliver duplicates during visibility. This illustrative model excludes that replication failure mode.

title: DeleteMessage
supports: A receipt changes on receive. The model strictly rejects stale tokens; SQS may accept an old handle without deleting, so this is not an SQS emulator.

title: Consumer Acknowledgements and Publisher Confirms
relevantSections: Consumer acknowledgements; automatic requeueing on connection loss
supports: Consumer acknowledgment differs from publisher confirmation. RabbitMQ channel/connection requeue differs from the illustrative lease schedule.

title: Making retries safe with idempotent APIs
relevantSections: Reducing client complexity with idempotent API design; atomic operations
supports: A request identity and its local mutation need a protected atomic boundary. External provider effects need separate coordination; this model deliberately contains no deduplication.
